component_strategies.header_nav: Sticky glassmorphism header (bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800 z-50) with club crest, quick squad metrics, 'Novo Jogador' button, search bar, and view toggle (Cards vs Table).
component_strategies.stats_summary_cards: 4 high-density metric widgets: Total de Jogadores (Blue badge), Ativos no Elenco (Green badge), Departamento Médico (Red alert badge), Contratos Vencendo (Yellow warning badge).
component_strategies.player_card: FIFA/EA Sports Tactical Card visual with player photo avatar, shirt number badge top-left, position badge top-right, physical stats (Altura/Peso/Pé), category (Sub-17, Profissional, etc.), and action bar (Ficha Completa, Editar, Excluir).
component_strategies.player_table: Dense analytical view featuring sortable columns, player thumbnail, status pill, position tag, category, contract remaining countdown, and actions.
component_strategies.player_form_modal:
Multi-tab structured modal/sheet ('Cadastro Completo de Jogador'):
1. Dados Pessoais (Nome, Apelido, Foto URL, Nasc, CPF, Pé)
2. Campo & Categoria (Posição Principal, Secundária, Categoria, Camisa, Status)
3. Medidas Físicas (Altura cm, Peso kg, % Gordura, Envergadura, Calçado)
4. Saúde & Fisiologia (Tipo Sanguíneo, Alergias, DM, Restrições)
5. Contrato & Vínculo (Início, Fim, Valor Mercado, Rescisão, Registro BID)
6. Responsável Legal (Nome, Telefone, E-mail, Parentesco)
7. Atributos & Scouting (Radar de Atributos 0-99: Velocidade, Chute, Passe, Drible, Defesa, Físico e Observações).
component_strategies.player_profile_modal:
Full dossier view (Ficha Técnica do Atleta):
- Printable layout header with print button
- Player photo card with rating badge
- Interactive Radar Chart (Recharts Radar) showing athletic attributes
- Medical history & physical evolution metrics
- Contract status tracker bar
- Responsible guardian contact card (for youth academy players).

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: Mandatory data-testid on every interactive element using kebab-case role naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load existing pre-populated realistic mock squad of at least 8-10 players covering all categories (Sub-15, Sub-17, Sub-20, Profissional) and positions (Goleiro, Zagueiro, Volante, Meia, Atacante).
Persist all changes (Create, Edit, Delete) to localStorage so refreshing the page preserves squad state.
Provide filtering by search text (name/nickname), category select, position select, and status select.
Integrate Shadcn primitives (Dialog, Tabs, Badge, Select, Button, Table, Input, Card, Checkbox, Sonner toast).
Include a radar attribute chart for player profiles using Recharts Radar Chart or custom SVG radar.
Support a PDF/Print dossier layout for the player profile so club staff can print physical scouting reports easily.
Maintain high visual distinction using Royal Blue (#1E40AF), Gold (#F59E0B), and Emerald (#10B981) matching the club crest.
